info.description: The Argentit Produce Detail Catalog API enables businesses to manage product details within the Argentit catalog. This API allows users to create and submit detailed information about their produce offerings, ensuring that all relevant attributes are captured and organized effectively. Common consumers of this API include inventory management systems and e-commerce platforms seeking to showcase Argentit products. By utilizing this API, businesses can streamline the process of cataloging their produce, enhancing visibility and accessibility for end users.

post.description: This endpoint allows users to submit detailed information regarding the production of argentit. It is crucial for tracking and managing production processes effectively.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to submit details for the Argentit produce operation. It requires a JSON object that adheres to the specified schema, containing all necessary fields for processing the request.

isPriority.description: A flag indicating whether the request is of high priority.
